title: Rename unlock expiry field and simplify upload limiter

source.message: Rename unlock expiry field and simplify upload limiter
source.note: Planted by the user; reverted by 50ed913. Applies cleanly on 892ddf8; reviewed there to keep the bugs of this commit only.

note: Two bugs: a renamed response field the web app still reads, and a limiter that leaks a slot when a task fails.

expected.description: GET /drops/:id returns unlockExpiresAt instead of unlockedUntil, but the web app (shared-drop.tsx, types/drop.ts) still reads data.unlockedUntil: the timer that shows the password prompt again when the unlock ends never runs.

When a task rejects, active is never decremented and next() is not called (the .finally was dropped): each failed upload leaks a concurrency slot, and after `concurrency` failures every queued upload hangs forever.
